research_question: Can an auxiliary normalized parameter loss select more stable solutions from the Q_param equivalence valley and lower held-out x0.95 error beyond pure Q_param?

routes.QP: L_Q + lambda_p * L_P; P is auxiliary only

checkpoint_rule: All QP checkpoints and lambda selection use validation L_Q only, never the combined training objective.

resource_gate.choose_extended_if: validation x0.95 rRMSE improves by at least 0.5% relative for Q and is no worse in at least 6 of 8 n-fold units, or baseline hits the epoch ceiling and extended is better

lambda_gate.selection: minimum pooled validation L_Q across the eight n-fold units
lambda_gate.stable_gain_rule: advance only if selected lambda improves validation x0.95 rRMSE over lambda=0 by at least 0.5% relative and is better in at least 6 of 8 n-fold units
lambda_gate.tie_rule: within 0.1% relative validation rRMSE of the best candidate, choose the smaller lambda_p

screening_test_policy: Do not evaluate or save test predictions for any resource or lambda candidate.

formal_gate.requires: separate user and mentor approval after screening
formal_gate.success: QP beats Q and P on frozen independent test x0.95 risk; primary paired design-level interval for QP-Q excludes zero in the favorable direction
formal_gate.fairness: P, Q, and QP use identical data, initialization, batch order, scaler, network, and selected training budget

excluded: multi-quantile auxiliary training in this pilot
paper claim or manuscript update before formal confirmation
